description: See how much of an area we have already searched for a term, when we last searched it, and how many places we have saved there. Use it to decide whether to collect again or just read the saved places. Needs an API key. Costs no credits and starts nothing.

geo.description: The area. Give exactly one of: a Brazilian city as location, a lat/lng point with radiusM, a bbox, or a cityIbge with radiusKm.

keywords.description: What you would search for, such as ["bakery"]. Coverage is per term: we may have searched an area for one and never for another.

lang.description: The language the search would run in. Two letters, such as pt or en.

name: get_coverage
title: Check an area's coverage
